- `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (`useCreateMemo` mutation hook, calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo`)
- `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)` — the generated Connect client instance)
- `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` in `service MemoService`)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (`ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo`, the Connect RPC entry point, delegates to `s.APIV1Service.CreateMemo`)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — builds `store.Memo` and calls `s.Store.CreateMemo`)
- `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` (`Store.CreateMemo` — validates UID, delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`)
- `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`DB.CreateMemo` — builds and executes the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ...` statement; equivalent dialect drivers exist at `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go`)
